title: 6-Phase Inverse VSD Transform
text: Compute vector space decomposition (VSD) based inverse transformation on orthogonal inputs, 1 input, 2 outputs; {Power invariant} sets the option to enable power invariant and {Motor type} sets the type of six-phase PMSM Asymmetric. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: αβxyz + z -
ports.summary: Six axis orthogonal components in three different subspaces scalar

ports.name: a 1 b 1 c 1
ports.summary: First set of three-phase outputs scalar

ports.name: a 2 b 2 c 2
ports.summary: Second set of three-phase outputs scalar

params.name: Power invariant
params.values: Option to enable power invariant transformation off (default) | on

params.name: Motor type
params.values: Type of six-phase PMSM Asymmetric (30 degree offset) (default) | Symmetric (60 degree offset)
